content: प्रजनन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) Producing, generating, procreative. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Procreation, generation, conception in the womb. .²2 Production, birth, delivery. .²3 Semen. .²4 The male or female organ of generation (penis or vulva); आत्मानमुभयोर्मध्ये यत्तत् प्रजननं विदुः <ls>Bhāg. 9. 14. 46</ls>. .²5 Offspring. .²6 Pregnancy of cattle (उपसर).
